senses.gloss:
I. 2 P. (वेति, rarely used in classical literature) 
__1 To go, move. 
__2 To approach. 
__3 To pervade. 
__4 To bring, convey. 
__5 To throw, cast. 
__6 To eat, consume. 
__7 to obtain. 
__8 To conceive, bring forth. 
__9 To be born or produced. 
__10 To shine, be beautiful. 
__11 To desire, wish. 
__12 To shine. --II. (वि + इ) 2 P. 
__1 To go away, depart; तस्यामहं त्वयि च संप्रति वीतचिन्तः [[Ś. 4. 13]]; so वीतभय, बीतक्रोध, etc. 
__2 To undergo a change; सदृशं त्रिषु लिङ्गेषु यन्न व्येति तदव्ययम् [[Sk.]] 
__3 To spend. 
__4 To be diffused, to spread. 
__5 To vanish, disappear. 
__6 To cross over, traverse.
